prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada the first time that The Toronto Maple Leafs won The Stanley Cup?
answer:
The Toronto Maple Leafs first won the Stanley Cup in **1932**, when **R. B. Bennett** was Prime Minister of Canada.

*(The franchise had previously won in 1918 as the Toronto Arenas, when Sir Robert Borden was prime minister.)*
